editorialScope: Verified and announced memory-centric compute products, plus explicitly tagged enabling memories. No geopolitical analysis.

companies.name: Yizhu Technology
companies.origin: No specific university spin-off established in reviewed sources.
companies.note: The vendor now emphasizes all-digital 3D DRAM. Historical RRAM descriptions should not be used as its current product architecture.

companies.name: MemSilicon
companies.origin: Incubated from the Chinese Academy of Sciences Institute of Microelectronics; Liu Ming research team. The company lists Prof. Liu Qi (Fudan University) among its co-founders.
companies.note: 2026 MountTai is an RRAM memory device, not a verified CIM MAC engine. LPU compute is a separate ongoing development.

companies.name: MicroNanoCore
companies.origin: Incubated at the Advanced Institute of Information Technology, Peking University (Zhejiang); not necessarily a formal university corporate spin-off.
companies.note: Other earlier chips shipped by the company are not evidence that the named 3D-CIM family has shipped.

companies.name: WITMEM
companies.origin: Founders have Peking University, UCLA and UCSB research backgrounds. Peking University–WITMEM joint CIM laboratory established in 2024; a joint lab is not evidence of formal university spin-off.
companies.note: WTM2101 achieved commercial manufacturing; WTM-8 has separately been described by the company as trial-manufactured.

companies.name: REEXEN
companies.origin: Founded by a team of PhDs from multiple universities; reviewed materials do not specify a single founding university lab.
companies.note: Large-capacity ADA400 platform and early ADA series have different deployment/maturity stages.

companies.name: Houmo AI
companies.origin: Founding team includes experienced AI chip researchers and industry engineers; a specific university lab spin-off has not been established.
companies.note: The company describes Beijing as its nationwide headquarters since March 2026. Cities represent verified offices/headquarters where available, not all independently confirmed as fabrication R&D.

companies.name: Dongfang Suanxin
companies.origin: Strong academic connection to Tsinghua University's software-defined/reconfigurable computing research led by Prof. Shaojun Wei; do not imply a formal corporate university spin-off without additional evidence.
companies.note: DF1000 is 3D stacked NMC; 6.4 TB/s is a vendor-reported figure whose measurement scope should be verified.

companies.name: PIMCHIP
companies.origin: Research-led founding team spanning Duke University ECE (Yiran Chen and former doctoral student Yaojun Zhang) and industry IC design. The ISSCC 2022 28 nm, 32 Kb ADC-less digital SRAM-CIM macro was a formal collaboration with Peking University's Huang Ru–Bonan Yan group (School of Integrated Circuits / Institute for Artificial Intelligence), Duke University, NeoNexus and PIMCHIP. Bonan Yan earned his Duke PhD under Yiran Chen and Hai Li. Academic collaboration is documented; formal university spin-off status is not established.
companies.note: The 2022 ISSCC result is a 32 Kb, 28 nm dynamic-logic-based ADC-less SRAM-CIM research macro (27.38 TOPS/W signed INT8; 1.041 Mb/mm² memory density), not an end-to-end S300 chip benchmark. Company website currently lists Beijing, Shanghai and Chengdu; older 36Kr profiles also report Hsinchu and Singapore offices, with current status unverified. Founder titles reflect their historically reported roles, not necessarily today's management.

people.name: Yiran Chen · 陈怡然
people.role: Co-founder and founding chairman (reported 2021–2022); Duke ECE professor; ISSCC 2022 coauthor

people.name: Yue Yang · 杨越
people.role: Co-founder and CEO (reported 2021–2026); former Micron system architect; ISSCC 2022 coauthor

people.name: Yaojun Zhang · 章尧君
people.role: Co-founder and founding CTO (reported 2021–2022); former Duke founder's doctoral student at Pittsburgh; ISSCC 2022 coauthor

people.name: Jeng-Long Hsu · 许振隆
people.role: Founding IC-design team member; former TSMC; ISSCC 2022 coauthor

people.name: Bonan Yan · 燕博南
people.role: ISSCC 2022 first author; PKU research leader; Duke PhD supervised by Yiran Chen and Hai Li

people.name: Ru Huang · 黄如
people.role: PKU research-group leader and ISSCC 2022 coauthor

companies.name: InnoMemTech
companies.origin: Technology and founding team originated in the School of Integrated Circuits, Tsinghua University; the company explicitly identifies this origin.
companies.note: 30M+ shipped units refers to standalone RRAM memory products, not 30M CIM AI accelerators.

companies.name: HSC Semiconductor
companies.origin: No university lab spin-off established in reviewed sources.
companies.note: CiNOR availability and array-level details should be checked directly against HSC publications.

companies.name: d-Matrix
companies.origin: Industry-founded by Sid Sheth and Sudeep Bhoja; no university spin-off identified.
companies.note: Offices are cited, but the source does not explicitly characterize every office as a hardware R&D site.

companies.name: Axelera AI
companies.origin: Industrial incubation by Bitfury AI with imec involvement; researchers previously worked at IBM, imec and other labs. Not classified as a university spin-off.
companies.note: Europa figures are from a separate generation to Metis. Do not infer shipping from product-announcement specifications alone.

companies.name: EnCharge AI
companies.origin: Research spin-out from Prof. Naveen Verma’s electrical engineering group at Princeton University; underpinning work was conducted over several years.
companies.note: Charge-domain analog CIM. EN100 metrics are vendor claims; system precision and ADC treatment merit independent validation.

companies.name: TetraMem
companies.origin: Co-founded by RRAM researchers including Miao Hu, Joshua Yang and Qiangfei Xia. No single official university spin-out claim established.
companies.note: MLX200 status should be compared using production/sample distinctions supplied by the company.

companies.name: Mythic
companies.origin: Founded by semiconductor and analog-architecture researchers; no specific verified university-lab spin-off classification.
companies.note: M1076 is an established architecture; Vanguard is a next-generation roadmap rather than an equivalent shipping SKU.

companies.name: UPMEM
companies.origin: Industrial/founding research history in memory processing; a specific formal university spin-off could not be established from sources reviewed.
companies.note: Processing occurs in DRAM chips, not by storing fixed neural weights in analog crossbar cells.

companies.name: SK hynix
companies.origin: Established integrated memory manufacturer; not a university spin-off.
companies.note: AiM demo material should not be conflated with the company’s standard commercial GDDR products.

companies.name: Samsung Electronics
companies.origin: Established semiconductor manufacturer; not a university spin-off.
companies.note: PIM demonstrations are separate from standard commercial DRAM and HBM production.

companies.name: GSI Technology
companies.origin: Established SRAM manufacturer; not a university spin-off.
companies.note: Associative/Boolean POPS cannot be converted directly to dense GEMM TOPS.

companies.name: NeuroBlade
companies.origin: Industry-founded data-processing company; university spin-off not verified.
companies.note: Specialized analytical query execution near data, not tensor MAC CIM.

companies.name: Synthara
companies.origin: Formal University of Zurich / ETH Zurich spin-off from the Institute of Neuroinformatics, founded by Manu V. Nair and Alessandro Aimar.
companies.note: ComputeRAM is embedded macro IP—not a standalone board or accelerator.

products.name: 3D-DRAM digital CIM family / YICA
products.system: Card / workstation / inference cluster marketed; exact capacity ND
products.throughput: Claimed 32 TB/s effective bandwidth (architecture figure; verify basis)
products.scale: PCIe / RoCE / RDMA; YZCCL cluster software
products.software: YICA ISA, CUDA-compatible compiler, PyTorch/Triton integration
products.maturity: Taped out; company says full-chain validated; volume status unclear
products.caveat: Important technology update: official 2026 site calls its core 3D DRAM; older articles label it RRAM. 88% TCO reduction vendor claim not independent benchmark.

products.name: MountTai 2026 (泰山一号)
products.class: Enabling memory technology; hybrid CIM roadmap
products.mode: Digital memory device; compute mode not specified
products.array: 1 Gb is storage-array capacity, NOT MAC-array capacity
products.software: RRAM IP; RRAM+DRAM hybrid CIM roadmap
products.maturity: Taped out 14 Oct 2026; undergoing verification
products.confidence: High for memory specs; no CIM product proof
products.caveat: Do not put 1 Gb into a compute-in-memory accelerator comparison as if RRAM MAC were validated.

products.name: 3D-CIM; PCIe-CIM; LP-CIM
products.locus: SRAM matrix engine coupled to vertically stacked memory
products.mode: Digital / mixed mode not fully disclosed
products.software: RV-CIM ISA; compiler; function libraries; simulator
products.maturity: Product/architecture announced; 2026 tapeout roadmap; shipment unverified
products.caveat: Volume claims from unrelated legacy chips cannot be credited to 3D-CIM products.

products.name: WTM2101
products.locus: Analog matrix/NN computation inside flash memory
products.scale: Standalone edge SoC; no multi-chip scale-up
products.software: WTM SDK / model tools; developer resources
products.maturity: Mass-production/fielded edge product (vendor)
products.caveat: Do not compare 50 GOPS with TOPS without unit normalization; flash analog array not equal whole MCU memory.

products.name: WTM-8
products.memory: Flash-derived proprietary 3D CIM; exact array medium ND
products.array: Vendor advertises 64M per core; unit/definition ambiguous
products.maturity: Published product pages; coming-soon/early production status needs confirmation
products.caveat: Do not silently convert 64M into MB or number of parameters; vendor did not state unit.

products.name: ADA100 / ADA200
products.locus: SRAM array mixed-signal multiply + ASP sensor preprocessing
products.precision: INT8 class; exact conversion details ND
products.power: Sub-mW ASP operating points claimed (not whole chip)
products.maturity: Older released/sampled edge devices; product shipments claimed
products.caveat: Differentiate always-on sensing power from neural engine peak power.

products.name: ADA300N / ADA300D / ADA400-DN-Board
products.locus: SRAM in-array MAC + vertical NAND/DRAM + attention
products.system: ADA400-DN-Board marketed at >2 TB (whole BOARD storage)
products.scale: Chiplets; vertical bonding; larger AI server
products.maturity: New platform/roadmap; no independent volume proof
products.caveat: 2 TB+ must not be presented as compute SRAM array. Claimed 4 TB/s not automatically external PCIe BW.

products.name: H30 (鸿途)
products.software: 后摩大道 / model compiler / deployment
products.maturity: Released commercial automotive/edge product (supplier claim)
products.caveat: Marketing TOPS/W across chip vs array differs.

products.name: M50 (漫界)
products.precision: INT8, INT16, FP16, FP32, bFP16, bFP24 supported
products.system: Up to 48 GB LPDDR5; up to 153.6 GB/s external BW
products.scale: PCIe Gen4 x4; HM-Link 16 GB/s; multi-die cards
products.software: Houmo Dadao stack; model conversion / runtime
products.maturity: Company-reported commercial volume in 2025/26
products.confidence: High primary source for announced specs
products.caveat: 48 GB is LPDDR5 capacity, not SRAM-CIM array; power excludes whole system/card unless stated.

products.name: Next-generation 3D CIM
products.maturity: Architecture roadmap; not shipping silicon
products.caveat: Do not attribute this 3D architecture to currently shipping M50.

products.name: DF1000 / QY100 / TY64
products.mode: Digital NMC; in-array MAC not evidenced
products.system: DF1000 / TY64 products; per-chip capacity ND
products.scale: DF1000 cards, QY100 servers, TY64 64-card server
products.maturity: DF1000 announced July 2026; independent volume status ND
products.caveat: 6.4 TB/s is vendor-internal memory BW claim, not external bandwidth.

products.name: PIMCHIP-S300
products.system: Up to 1,792 KB system SRAM; up to 32 MB PSRAM
products.power: 100 μW–5 mW is AON subsystem only
products.software: RTOS, middleware, model zoo, one-click deployment
products.maturity: Published product
products.caveat: DO NOT interpret AON subsystem power as 0.5-TOPS operating power.

products.name: RRAM AI chips / embedded IP
products.locus: RRAM analog/heterogeneous compute claimed; memory IP distinct
products.maturity: Standalone RRAM memory in production since 2021; AI CIM SoC status separate
products.caveat: Vendor says >30M standalone RRAM memory chips shipped—not proof of 30M CIM accelerator shipments.

products.name: CiNOR (Flash CIM)
products.maturity: Prototype / technology activity; product detail limited
products.caveat: Memory production alone should not be conflated with proven CIM accelerator shipment.

products.name: Corsair
products.locus: Digital compute tightly integrated with SRAM
products.memory: 2 GB on-card compute SRAM + off-card LPDDR5
products.array: 2 GB of integrated Performance Memory per card (aggregate; not one macro)
products.system: Up to 256 GB LPDDR5 capacity memory / card
products.throughput: 2,400 TFLOPS MXINT8; 9,600 TFLOPS MXINT4; 150 TB/s local SRAM BW
products.coprocessor: Digital MAC, control and vector operators
products.scale: PCIe Gen5, DMX Link/Bridge; multi-card racks
products.maturity: Full production announced June 2026; volume shipment beginning
products.confidence: High primary specs; availability is vendor claim
products.caveat: 2 GB is distributed compute SRAM on a card; 256 GB LPDDR is capacity memory. Peak TFLOPS not measured LLM goodput.

products.name: Raptor 3D DRAM
products.software: Aviator ecosystem likely; not a supported SKU
products.maturity: Roadmap / concept
products.caveat: Do not confuse next-gen Raptor concept with Corsair shipping memory hierarchy.

products.name: Metis
products.locus: True in-SRAM-array MVM across 4 AI cores
products.power: Board-dependent; core power claims not whole system
products.coprocessor: 4 IMC cores + host CPU for prep/post
products.scale: PCIe Gen3 x4; multiple AIPUs per board
products.software: Voyager SDK, compiler, model zoo, ONNX / Python
products.maturity: Commercial M.2 / PCIe / compute boards
products.caveat: Vendor documentation uses ambiguous TOPS/MAC wording: align MAC convention before comparative ranking.

products.name: Europa
products.locus: More in-SRAM compute cores with RISC-V vector processors
products.memory: SRAM-CIM + up to 64 GB backing memory
products.array: 128 MB L2 SRAM; 8 IMC cores (macro breakdown ND)
products.system: Up to 64 GB module memory; 200 GB/s DRAM bandwidth
products.scale: Multi-chip support for larger models claimed
products.maturity: Next-generation product / announced; volume unverified
products.caveat: Do not represent as currently shipping in the same way as Metis.

products.name: EN100 M.2 / 4-chip PCIe
products.locus: Charge-domain analog MAC on capacitor-SRAM-like arrays
products.precision: INT8 peak; other precision digital path ND
products.throughput: >200 TOPS M.2; up to ~1 POPS 4-chip PCIe
products.maturity: Announced; early access/sampling; independent benchmarks limited
products.caveat: Do not divide 200 TOPS by 8.25 W and call it directly comparable to peak 40 TOPS/W: envelope vs core efficiency differ.

products.name: MLX200
products.precision: ONNX compiler INT8 / INT4; physical 8-bit multilevel claims
products.system: On-array nonvolatile weights; external memory ND
products.software: ONNX compile + quantization, C++ and RISC-V
products.maturity: Silicon validation May 2026; eval kits expected H2 2026
products.confidence: High primary for stage and specs
products.caveat: 2026 production shipments shown on roadmap; independently confirmed volume not found.

products.name: M1076 AMP
products.maturity: Earlier shipped/sampled generation; current market availability uncertain
products.caveat: Performance applies to M1076 generation; do not mix with planned Vanguard.

products.name: Vanguard
products.locus: Flash analog IMC die and digital die / hybrid
products.maturity: Future product advertised for 2027
products.caveat: Do not count as 2026 shipping product.

products.name: DRAM-PIM DDR4 DIMM
products.precision: 32-bit RISC (not native GEMM INT8 precision metric)
products.scale: Host-mediated inter-DPU; no direct DPU-to-DPU network
products.software: UPMEM C / Rust SDK, host APIs, compiler
products.maturity: Commercial dev and server deployments
products.caveat: 2.56 TB/s aggregate local DPU bandwidth is not CPU/DIMM interface bandwidth; not a native tensor TOPS product.

products.name: GDDR6-AiM / AiMX
products.locus: Digital vector processing near DRAM banks
products.throughput: 1 TFLOPS BF16 per chip; 64 GB/s external chip BW
products.coprocessor: AiM controller, CPU/GPU host, FPGA ref platform
products.scale: AiMX accelerator board; GPU co-processing demos
products.maturity: Physical prototype / demonstration; no high-volume AiMX evidence
products.caveat: 8 Gb DRAM capacity is not processing array weights; PUs inserted alongside banks.

products.name: HBM2-PIM / Aquabolt-XL
products.locus: Processing units in HBM DRAM bank-periphery
products.system: HBM stack memory; exact SKU varies
products.maturity: Demonstrated prototype; mass-market PIM availability unclear
products.caveat: Do not conflate commercial HBM4 shipments with computing-enabled HBM-PIM.

products.name: LPDDR5X-PIM (2026 demo)
products.throughput: Company reports up to 8× effective BW and 2–3× inference throughput in selected demos
products.maturity: 2026 demo / precommercial
products.caveat: Do not treat relative demo speedups as independent all-workload benchmarks.

products.name: Gemini I / Gemini II APU
products.precision: Variable bit-level Boolean operations (not directly GEMM INT8)
products.maturity: Gemini I full production limited sales; Gemini II preproduction in 2026 SEC filing
products.caveat: Very important: Boolean POPS cannot be meaningfully compared with neural MAC TOPS; APU revenue immaterial per SEC filing.

products.name: SPU / DAXL
products.locus: Compute engines close to memory for SQL/analytics
products.precision: Data-analytics operators, not ML INT8 MAC
products.throughput: Database query workload metrics, not NN TOPS
products.maturity: Commercial customer deployments claimed
products.caveat: Strong PNM use case for databases; not an LLM inference tensor engine.

products.name: ComputeRAM IP
products.system: Licensed embedded IP, NOT stand-alone accelerator
products.throughput: Performance application-dependent; no fixed TOPS public
products.maturity: Available semiconductor IP / reference implementation
products.caveat: Macro kilobytes cannot be compared with card backing LPDDR gigabytes.

products.name: PIMCHIP-N300
products.software: Vendor NPU development stack; details ND
products.maturity: Announced August 2024
products.caveat: Precision support may involve fallback or datapath sharing; physical SRAM macro bit widths have not been independently documented.
